title: Quest live bilateral arm/head simulation pilot

arm_head.neutral_instruction: Press and release the left trigger to return the simulated arms/head to joint zero. Hold the right trigger to apply the vendor's absolute waist-frame wrist poses; the first sample starts the session but does not redefine arm neutral.
arm_head.controlled_endpoint: vendor R1_A5 virtual EE: 0.20 m along wrist_roll_link local +x
arm_head.rate_limit_source: T007 offline replay of t007_live_arm_head_20260817T114118Z: 1.5 rad/s and 4.0 rad/s^2 reduced mean target-to-limited-command endpoint error from 0.128/0.131 m (left/right) to 0.078/0.080 m while remaining below the R1 URDF motor velocity limits. Simulation-only tuning; not a hardware safety limit.

invalid_if: the neutral session record is missing
scientific_failure_if: head/arm dynamic tracking must be assessed from recorded traces before a pass claim
validity.joint_limit_policy: T007 simulation dispatches exact IK solutions and bounded best-effort projections for poses outside the reachable set. Position residual, solver status and clamped joints are recorded. Wrist roll is clamped to its URDF limit. This is not a hardware policy.
validity.collision_status: inconclusive because functional arm tracking requires the documented self-collision workaround
